description: This source file provides extension methods for configuring Azure Table Storage as silo grain storage within an Orleans-based application. It includes methods for adding storage with default or custom options, and registers necessary services and validators.

classes.name: AzureTableSiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for configuring Azure Table Storage in Orleans silo builders.

methods.name: AddAzureTableGrainStorageAsDefault
methods.description: Configures the silo to use Azure Table Storage as the default grain storage with options provided via an action.

methods.name: AddAzureTableGrainStorage
methods.description: Configures the silo to use Azure Table Storage for grain storage with a specified name and options.

methods.name: AddAzureTableGrainStorageAsDefault (overload)
methods.description: Configures the silo to use Azure Table Storage as the default grain storage with options provided via OptionsBuilder.

methods.name: AddAzureTableGrainStorage (overload)
methods.description: Configures the silo to use Azure Table Storage for grain storage with a specified name and options via OptionsBuilder.

methods.name: AddAzureTableGrainStorage (internal method)
methods.description: Adds the Azure Table Grain Storage services to the DI container with optional configuration.
